title: The Wildman of Whitehall
full_text_transcript: Local hunting party reports encounter near the cliffs above Lake Champlain. Witnesses observed a seven-foot tall creature covered in shaggy dark fur bounding up a steep rock face after being startled.

title: Raging Monster of the Red River
full_text_transcript: Settlers along the frozen Red River basin chased a massive hairy 'wild man' across frozen marshlands. Witnesses described an animal with huge shoulders and bear-like agility capable of breaking thick ice with its arms.

title: Strange Footprints in the Timber
full_text_transcript: Hunters near the Cuyahoga River valley discovered a series of massive human-like tracks measuring over sixteen inches in length, deeply impressed into frozen clay near a river bend.

title: Border Monster Terrifies Homesteads
full_text_transcript: Farmers along the Red River valley report repeated nighttime disturbances involving heavy wood knocking on timber barns, broken fence rails, and unexplainable guttural roaring.

title: Ape-Beast Encountered by Loggers
full_text_transcript: Logging crew operating near Mount Rainier reports observing a massive, ape-like figure watching their camp from a timbered ridge before vanishing into dense brush without making a sound.

title: The Ten-Foot Wildman of Moosehead
full_text_transcript: Woodcutters 100 miles north of Moosehead Lake reported a ten-foot tall wild man covered in shaggy brown hair with long arms, leaving oversized tracks along forest streams.

title: Giant Man-Beast in the Lewis County Hills
full_text_transcript: Local citizens and doctors report a giant creature covered in thick hair haunting mountain thickets. A resident who attempted to approach was showered with rocks before the beast bounded uphill.

title: The Cave Creature of Orange County
full_text_transcript: Farm workers near Glenmere Lake observed a hair-covered humanoid emerge from a rocky cave. When offered food, the creature gritted its teeth and retreated swiftly back into the cave interior.
